qs.s: Ce ___ a démontré un nouveau théorème après des années de recherche.
qs.en: This mathematician proved a new theorem after years of research.

qs.en: She interviewed a famous mathematician who works on number theory.

qs.s: Il rêve de devenir ___ mathématicien reconnu dans le monde entier.
qs.en: He dreams of becoming a recognized mathematician throughout the world.

qs.s: On m'a présenté ___ mathématicien qui a résolu ce problème.
qs.en: I was introduced to the mathematician who solved this problem.

qs.s: Dans l'orchestre, elle joue de la ___ depuis dix ans.
qs.en: In the orchestra, she has played the flute for ten years.

qs.s: Le concert commence par un solo de ___.
qs.en: The concert opens with a flute solo.

qs.s: À l'école primaire, les enfants apprennent à jouer de la ___.
qs.en: In primary school, children learn to play the flute (recorder).

qs.s: Il a acheté une petite ___ en plastique pour son fils.
qs.en: He bought a small plastic recorder for his son.

qs.en: She raised her champagne flute to make a toast.

qs.s: Le sommelier a servi le champagne dans une ___ élégante.
qs.en: The sommelier served the champagne in an elegant flute glass.

qs.en: This long thin loaf of bread you buy at the bakery is called a flûte.

qs.s: Pour ce sandwich, prends plutôt une ___, plus fine que la baguette classique.
qs.en: For this sandwich, get a flûte instead, thinner than a classic baguette.

qs.en: She would like to buy a recorder for her music class.

qs.en: The boss organized a company party at a large nightclub with a show and champagne.

qs.en: After the wedding, the guests continued the party at a neighborhood nightclub until dawn.

qs.en: The teenagers meet every Friday at this disco to dance to the latest hits.

qs.en: The DJ was mixing electronic music tracks in the disco packed with dancers.

qs.s: Mon grand-père conserve une immense ___ de vinyles des années 1960 dans son grenier.
qs.en: My grandfather keeps a huge record collection of 1960s vinyls in his attic.

qs.en: The municipal library has a record library where you can borrow CDs for free.

qs.en: He invested all his savings to open a nightclub right in the city center.

qs.s: ___ discothèque du village a définitivement fermé ses portes le mois dernier.
